notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only dated source is the 2014 extant list in the Division of Forestry multiple property document; the Tennessee Landforms list is undated and says its history is still being gathered. Agency is inferred from the tower being on that Division of Forestry list, not stated for this tower. No build date, builder, height, design, staffing or access information in any source read. Web searches found no Spencer tower history; one search snippet mentions a fire that destroyed Spencer's county administrative building and older records, but that page was not read and is not used. A different NHLR entry, Fall Creek Falls Lookout Tower (US 50, TN 1), appeared in search and was not checked against this site. Whether the tower still stands is unknown after 2014.
